description: This script manages build processes for a project using Node.js. It includes functions to clean up symbolic links, execute build commands via 'pnpm', and interpret build output to detect unresolved or ineffective dynamic imports, ensuring proper build state and logging.

methods.name: removeDistPluginNodeModulesSymlinks
methods.description: Removes symbolic links to node_modules within the 'extensions' subdirectory of the specified root directory.

methods.name: pruneStaleRuntimeSymlinks
methods.description: Removes stale runtime symlinks in 'dist' and 'dist-runtime' directories to clean build environment.

methods.name: findFatalUnresolvedImport
methods.description: Parses build output lines to locate unresolved import errors not originating from project dependencies or internal paths.
